opportunities.name: Power Fist AD uppercut
opportunities.objective: Make the doubled-AD empowered attack the primary burst.
opportunities.mechanic: Power Fist explicitly deals 2 AD plus 0.25 AP physical damage and knocks up for one second. Essence Reaver supplies a separate physical Spellblade payload; Sundered Sky can reward the first champion attack with healing. Bloodmail turns purchased health into AD, W supplies five seconds of attack speed, and Cleaver supports physical follow-up.
opportunities.requiredState: Need Q connection or melee access, E ready and W exit planned before its self-slow.
opportunities.failure: Q/R magic damage loses AP scaling, and the carry can disengage after the knockup.
opportunities.test: Log base E, Spellblade and Sundered Sky components independently before comparing a three-attack trade.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not multiply all item bonus damage by E's 2 AD coefficient or assume E crit stacking.

opportunities.name: Mana-shield lightning boxer
opportunities.objective: Turn a mana reserve into a durable repeated-attack threat.
opportunities.mechanic: Mana Barrier gives a shield equal to 35% of the ability resource expression, while available R marks attacked targets for delayed magic shocks with an AP ratio and 0.02 resource expression. Seraph and Frozen Heart add mana, Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward actual W-assisted attacks, and Visage enhances received shields. Holding R preserves lightning availability.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Tear, enough current resource, R unspent and time for one-second shocks.
opportunities.failure: Casting R removes the available-ultimate premise; spending mana before the shield can reduce protection.
opportunities.test: Compare shield and delayed shock damage at full versus spent mana while keeping R active unused.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not read ability resource default as unquestionably maximum mana or free permanent damage.

ruledOut.reason: Rocket Grab and Static Field deal magic damage; lethality only serves attacks and physical E.

unknowns: Current-versus-maximum mana interpretation, R re-mark timing and E/Sundered Sky crit treatment need live logs.

builds.summary: Make the doubled-AD empowered attack the primary burst.
builds.goal: Make the doubled-AD empowered attack the primary burst.
builds.hypothesis: Power Fist explicitly deals 2 AD plus 0.25 AP physical damage and knocks up for one second. Essence Reaver supplies a separate physical Spellblade payload; Sundered Sky can reward the first champion attack with healing. Bloodmail turns purchased health into AD, W supplies five seconds of attack speed, and Cleaver supports physical follow-up.
testPlan: Required state: Need Q connection or melee access, E ready and W exit planned before its self-slow.
Log base E, Spellblade and Sundered Sky components independently before comparing a three-attack trade.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Q/R magic damage loses AP scaling, and the carry can disengage after the knockup.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Do not multiply all item bonus damage by E's 2 AD coefficient or assume E crit stacking.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Essence Reaver, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Blitzcrank fires their right hand, Pulling the first enemy hit towards them and dealing [110 / 160 / 210 / 260 / 310 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage.

Blitzcrank supercharges themself, gaining [(0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × 100]% decaying Move Speed and [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7) × 100]% Attack Speed for [5] seconds.

Afterwards, Blitzcrank is Slowed by [30]% for [1.5] seconds.
